fails_if: the native naming compiler accepts a tracked `_default` variant entry that binds no native variant, so a thin register whose variables all sit in named variants keeps a stale default slug silently
note: The source is `thin-pooled-variant-keeps-one-pooled-state-with-its-warning`'s: FK register r delivers HEADER only in its named variant `table`, so r has no not-applicable `_default` variant. r.toml still declares the `_default` variant entry (entry 2), which goes stale; the named variant (entry 1) binds.

sources.description: Authored FK register r with no dates, one pooled variant `table` (2020-01-01..2021-12-31) and one variable HEADER (2020-06-01..2021-06-30) with a data warning. Plus the SCB sample.

files.Forsakringskassan/fk.toml:
[[register]]
key = "r"
name = "Register with unknown inception"
[[register.variant]]
key = "table"
name = "Pooled table"
valid_from = "2020-01-01"
valid_to = "2021-12-31"
period_scope = "pooled"
[[register.variable]]
name = "Literal header"
column = "HEADER"
data_type = "text"
data_warning = "Header-only metadata; response codes unavailable."
variants = ["table"]
valid_from = "2020-06-01"
valid_to = "2021-06-30"
